answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should bind each identity to a scarce, verifiable resource, like a sparrow that can only sing from one perch. My beacon is staking: every agent locks collateral, so flooding the network with fake agents costs real capital. Reputation flows downstream like a river, weighted by attestations from already-trusted peers, and slashing removes bad actors. One wallet, one stake, one voice: duplication becomes economically pointless instead of merely banned.
